desc: Validate the min-cost-flow / LP-duality theory on all three samples (min ones(D) = sum_{c_i<D}(D-c_i)).

Implement solution: BFS for L; convex-cost min-cost flow (per-edge forward cost 0 if unused else 1; backward cost -1 if h>=2 else 0); successive shortest augmenting paths (Bellman-Ford) recording marginals; stop after K+1 recordings or next cost >= L.
For D from L down to 0 compute cost(D)=sum_{c_i<D}(D-c_i) and output the largest D with cost(D)<=K (D=0 always feasible).
Run on Sample 1 (1), Sample 2 (2), Sample 3 (0) -- all passed.
Cross-check against brute-force over all K-subsets on small graphs (N<=6, M<=8), including multi-edge/duplicate cases -- no counterexample found.
Stress-test truncation logic (stop after K+1 marginals / marginal >= L) -- verified it never drops a marginal that changes the answer for D <= L.
